## 4.5 wall cascade
wall column | before | y0 cobblestone_wall[east=none,north=none,south=none,up=true,waterlogged=false,west=none] y1 cobblestone_wall[east=none,north=none,south=none,up=true,waterlogged=false,west=none] y2 cobblestone_wall[east=none,north=none,south=none,up=true,waterlogged=false,west=none]
wall column | wall east of top | y0 cobblestone_wall[east=none,north=none,south=none,up=true,waterlogged=false,west=none] y1 cobblestone_wall[east=none,north=none,south=none,up=true,waterlogged=false,west=none] y2 cobblestone_wall[east=low,north=none,south=none,up=true,waterlogged=false,west=none]
wall column | wall east of bottom | y0 cobblestone_wall[east=low,north=none,south=none,up=true,waterlogged=false,west=none] y1 cobblestone_wall[east=none,north=none,south=none,up=true,waterlogged=false,west=none] y2 cobblestone_wall[east=none,north=none,south=none,up=true,waterlogged=false,west=none]
